[P1] Account for exclusive waiters when acquiring work permits

The suspended-owner deadlock remains with `scenarioConcurrency: 1`: A suspends and releases capacity while retaining ownership, then B takes the sole permit and requests an exclusive lease on the same target. B waits for A to retire, while A's `reserve_capacity()` waits for B's permit. Otherwise valid cases stall until a harness timeout. Coordinate permit and lease admission so blocked exclusive waiters cannot consume permits needed by existing owners, and add a regression covering this sequence.
